service.description: Receive a customer return shipment's lines: for each return item the quantity that arrived, accepted and rejected (quarantined) alike, received as stock (AssetReceipt) on the item's shipment source, added to ReturnItem.receivedQuantity. It never changes returnQuantity and processes no response, so a second box, or units rejected at the dock, can still be received and credited against the authorization by settle#Return. An item reaches ReturnReceived (ReturnManResp for a manual response) when its received quantity equals the authorized quantity, the return when every item is handled, and the shipment ShipDelivered when every source is handled. Refuses more than was authorized (RECEIPT_EXCEEDS_RETURN), an item not on the shipment, a closed item, a shipment that is not a customer return, and an organization that does not settle returns separately (RETURN_SETTLEMENT_OFF: Mantle receives its returns when the shipment is delivered). Needs STOCK_RECEIVE in the receiving organization.

parameter.name: facilityId
parameter.description: Defaults to the shipment's destination facility.

parameter.name: itemList
parameter.description: Maps of returnId, returnItemSeqId, quantityAccepted, quantityRejected, rejectionReasonEnumId and, for the stock, statusId (default AstOnHold) and lotNumber.

parameter.name: receivedItems
parameter.description: Each item's returnId, returnItemSeqId, receivedQuantity, statusId and assetReceiptIds.

service.description: Move an asset, or part of it, to a location or a container of its own facility, through mantle.product.AssetServices.move#Asset: a part becomes its own asset there, the whole asset moves, and the reservations it carries move with it as Mantle moves them. A retry with the same operation key and request answers the first move (alreadyApplied); a different request under the key is OPERATION_KEY_CONFLICT. Refuses without STOCK_MOVE (PERMISSION_DENIED); an asset outside the user's facilities (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), equipment (NOT_STOCK), nothing on hand (NO_STOCK), a quantity above on hand (QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_ON_HAND); another facility (OTHER_FACILITY: a transfer); a closed or missing location (LOCATION_CLOSED, LOCATION_UNAVAILABLE); the place it is already (SAME_LOCATION); a container holding another owner's stock (CONTAINER_OWNER); a quarantined asset to a location whose type would release it, or any status change with no status flow transition (HELD_STOCK, F8). Reservations carried onto stock that is not available are checked again, so the order is re-reserved on available stock (F38). Expired and near-expiry stock moves with a warning naming its date. workEffortId is the production run a staging move is for, kept in the answer.

Each in its own transaction: one that fails is named and the others go on. Requires STOCK_POLICY_MANAGE (PERMISSION_DENIED) and a facility of the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE). On-hand, the reservation and the line's quantities are not changed: reallocation or a reviewed adjustment resolves the difference. A retry with the same operation key answers the first. Requires SHIPMENT_PICK; refuses as pick#ShipmentStock for the shipment and line, a quantity not above zero (QUANTITY_INVALID) or above what is left unpicked and not already short (QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_REMAINING), no reason (REASON_REQUIRED) or another kind of value (REASON_INVALID, RESOLUTION_INVALID), an asset that is not the line's stock here (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a location not of the facility (LOCATION_UNAVAILABLE), and neither (LOCATION_REQUIRED).

service.description: Put back picked stock of a line (design Pick PutBack; Unpick): only once the picker confirms (CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED, nothing moves before), the quantity (by default the line's putBackQuantity, which cancel#OrderItem flags when a cancelled balance leaves more picked than the line's quantity, else all picked and not packed) moved out of the pick container back to the location each guarded pick took it from (or toLocationSeqId), an unpick taking the line's reservation with it so the allocation is restored, a cancelled balance moving none (the line's remaining reservation stays on the picked stock, which cancel#OrderItem re-reserves, F262); each put back names the pick it consumed (pickKey), so a chosen location does not count the pick twice; the line's quantityPicked lowered and its flag cleared; a picked shipment that is short again goes back to Scheduled. Stock picked without a container moves nothing (untrackedQuantity), but a shipment with a pick container refuses quantity no recorded pick covers (UNTRACKED_PICK: move it instead). A retry answers the first. Requires SHIPMENT_PICK; refuses as pick#ShipmentStock for the shipment and line, a packed shipment (ALREADY_PACKED: put back from Pack), nothing to put back (NOTHING_TO_PUT_BACK), more than is picked and not packed (QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_PICKED), a pick with no location to return to (LOCATION_REQUIRED), and a closed location (LOCATION_CLOSED).

For a picklist (workEffortId, SHIPMENT_LOAD_EDIT): its shipments not picked yet must be acknowledged (acknowledged Y, else OUTSTANDING names them), then mantle.work.ShipmentWorkServices.complete#ShipmentLoadShip takes them off the load and completes it. service.description: Scrap free stock (WH-SCRAP): an asset, or part of it, perhaps moved first to a morgue location of its facility (move#Asset; the location type's status, AstMorgue), then taken out of stock through record#PhysicalInventoryChange with a scrap reason (InVrScrap or InVrExpired, enumCode scrap) or InVrDamaged, on a PhysicalInventory of its own marked scrapIndicator Y, one per operation (F5), which Counts leave out. The variance posts by its reason (post#PhysicalInventoryVariance: the organization's VarianceReasonGlAccount, then the asset type's scrapGlAccountId). service.description: CompletePack (design Pack): check the packed quantities (Packing.js completePlan: something packed, every packed product in a package, no empty package and a weight on each, picked stock packed or put back, what is left unpacked acknowledged) and release the shipment to shipping through Mantle's complete#ShipmentPack with getLabels and getReturnLabels false (F17): no label is requested here, labels are bought in Ship (P13). pack#Shipment lowers each line to what was packed, returns unused kit components, sets ShipPacked, and its SECA (ShipmentOutgoingPackedCreateInvoices, which BOSS keeps) creates the sales invoice; with the organization's salesInvoiceFinalizedAtShip (D3) it stays in process until the shipment ships. complete#ShipmentPack commits the pack in its own transaction, so the checks hold no lock across it (F276): a retry answers the first by the operation key. Requires SHIPMENT_PACK; refuses a shipment outside the user's facilities (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), shipped (SHIPMENT_SHIPPED) or packed (PACK_CLOSED), NOTHING_PACKED, UNPACKAGED, EMPTY_PACKAGE, WEIGHT_REQUIRED, PUT_BACK_FIRST, OUTSTANDING (until acknowledged), and a pack Mantle did not complete (PACK_FAILED).

service.description: ReopenPackage (design Pack): take a package's contents (or, with productId and quantity, part of one product in it) back off a shipment that has not shipped, for a correction or a reduced line, once the packer confirms with a reason. A packed shipment's sales invoice is released first through Accounting's release#ShipmentInvoiceLines (the release of release#ShipmentDraftInvoice, F275; impl-accounting P17): behind D3's flag it is still in process between pack and ship, so its lines and billing links come off it and packing again bills again; a finalized invoice keeps the package closed (INVOICE_FINALIZED: correct it with a credit memo). Then the shipment goes back to Picked and unpack#ShipmentItemIssuance (F11) cancels each issued quantity, newest first, its reservation restored on the same asset (never reset), and the package's contents are lowered; the stock stays where it was packed, for Pick's put back or another pack. A retry answers the first. Requires SHIPMENT_PACK; refuses CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED, REASON_REQUIRED, a shipment outside the user's facilities (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), SHIPMENT_SHIPPED, PACKAGE_UNAVAILABLE, NOTHING_TO_REOPEN, QUANTITY_INVALID, QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_PACKED and INVOICE_FINALIZED.

parameter.name: result
parameter.description: resultCode REOPENED, shipmentId, shipmentPackageSeqId, unpacked (productId, quantity, assetIssuanceIds), releasedInvoiceIds, cancelledInvoiceIds, releasedItemCount, statusId, reason, and the operation fields.

return.message: CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED: Confirm the reopen; nothing changes until you do
REASON_REQUIRED: Say why the package is reopened
SHIPMENT_SHIPPED: Shipment ${shipmentId} has shipped; change it with a return
PACK_CLOSED: Shipment ${shipmentId} is ${sh.shipment.statusId}
INVOICE_FINALIZED: Invoice ${finalized.invoiceId} of shipment ${shipmentId} is final, so the package stays closed; correct it with a credit memo
